profile: A home cook and allotment gardener who reads about fermentation, growing vegetables and seasonal cooking.
shelf: 1. Keeping a Sourdough Starter Alive — A diary-style piece on the daily ritual of feeding a sourdough starter and why slow fermentation makes better bread.
2. Why Your Sourdough Starter Has Stalled — An explainer diagnosing the common causes of a sluggish sourdough starter and how to restart fermentation.
3. A Baker's Diary: Rye Sourdough in Autumn — A personal essay on baking rye sourdough through autumn and treating fermentation as part of seasonal cooking.
4. Two Kimchi Recipes for a Small Kitchen — A practical how-to comparing a quick and a slow method for making kimchi at home.
5. The Many Regional Faces of Kimchi — An essay surveying how kimchi varies by region and season across Korea, and why it belongs to seasonal cooking.
6. A Fermenting Weekend: Kimchi and Kombucha Together — A light blog post about spending a weekend making kimchi alongside a batch of kombucha.
7. From Seed to Sauce: A Year of Growing Tomatoes — A personal essay following a year of growing tomatoes, saving seeds, feeding the compost heap, and keeping bees on the side.
8. Pruning and Training Tomatoes in Raised Beds — A how-to guide on pruning tomato vines grown in raised beds and why soil health underpins the whole method.
9. Community Garden Reports Bumper Tomato Harvest — A news-style report on a community garden's tomato harvest, its compost programme and a seed saving swap.
10. Building Raised Beds Before the Spring Rush — A how-to guide on building raised beds in late winter, with an aside on the beekeeping that will follow once beds are settled.
11. Keeping the Compost Heap Working Through Winter — An essay on maintaining an active compost heap and healthy soil through the cold months, feeding next year's raised beds.
12. A Practical Guide to Saving Seeds — A how-to guide on saving seeds from this year's tomatoes and other vegetables to protect soil health and reduce yearly costs.
13. Keeping Bees Alongside the Vegetable Beds — An essay on taking up beekeeping at an allotment and folding the honey harvest into seasonal cooking, with soil health as an unexpected benefit.
